textContent.text: Sandpaper can be used to make a rough surface, such as wood, smooth. It has three layers.
The bottom layer is called the backing. It can be made of paper or another flexible material.
The top layer is called the abrasive. The abrasive is the scratchy part of sandpaper. Sand can be used as the abrasive, but other materials are used too.
The middle layer is the glue. It holds the backing and the abrasive together.

Heating and cooling can cause matter to change from one state to another. How do
happen?

The particles in a solid are always vibrating, but they cannot move past each other. If the solid is heated, the particles can gain enough thermal energy to begin sliding past each other. As this change is happening, the solid is
into a liquid.
If the liquid is heated further, the particles can break away from each other and begin spreading out quickly. As this change is happening, the liquid is
into a gas.

into a liquid. If cooling continues, the particles in the liquid will stop sliding past each other. As this change is happening, the liquid is
into a solid.

pieces.text: Solid, liquid, and gas are common states of matter. In all three states, the particles are constantly bouncing off each other. The energy of this bouncing motion is called
The amount of thermal energy matter has can change. During
, thermal energy increases and the particles move faster. During
, thermal energy decreases and the particles move slower.
Heating and cooling can cause matter to change from one state to another. How do
happen?

The particles in a solid are always vibrating, but they cannot move past each other. If the solid is heated, the particles can gain enough thermal energy to begin sliding past each other. As this change is happening, the solid is
into a liquid.
If the liquid is heated further, the particles can break away from each other and begin spreading out quickly. As this change is happening, the liquid is
into a gas.
Now, if the gas is cooled, the gas particles can begin
into a liquid. If cooling continues, the particles in the liquid will stop sliding past each other. As this change is happening, the liquid is
into a solid.
A change of state can happen between
. And these changes of state are usually caused by changes in how much thermal energy the matter has.
